The visible foreleg and general body shape do not show obvious melting or extra limbs. The topology auditor's high confidence mask suggests the object is coherent. Therefore, the Router's severity ratings are appropriate, but the pose auditor's warning warrants a slight penalty in the artifact score to account for potential subtle structural ambiguities in the tucked limbs.

The 2 untestable checkpoints (nose action, tail underside) are due to image constraints (static/resolution/pose), not generation failure. The alignment is very high.
